textbook_notes.caution: All 50 numbered problems are represented. Problem 2.19 conflicts with Tables 1–2: triangle-free deletion, linear-forest deletion and 3-leaf-power deletion/editing already have NOSUB lower bounds there; those subparts are excluded. Table-only questions are included and tables were inspected visually. Dash-marked cells are grouped as exploratory directions, following the authors’ weaker status. Problem 3.9 literally names parameter L although its setup also uses k; no silent correction is made.
